notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with Muldrotha.
description:
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Muldrotha by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
Muldrotha enters the battlefield, triggering Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability, repairing Deadeye Navigator and Muldrotha.
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may cast any number of permanent card(s) from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability.
